items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction: GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker: Texas leads, new markets emerge

items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction: GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker: Texas leads, new markets emerge

items.title: US Rates Weekly: Can Secretary Bessent and Chair Warsh save the curve?

items.quote_zh: 在財政部本週調高長端買回規模之後，我們做多了 20 年期公債。

items.title: US Rates Weekly: Can Secretary Bessent and Chair Warsh save the curve?
items.quote: In our view a hawkish Fed would likely hinder rather than help our trade. We see little evidence that tighter Fed policy would transmit into lower and more stable long-end yields.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為鷹派的聯準會比較可能扯這筆交易的後腿，而不是幫上忙。我們幾乎看不到證據顯示更緊的聯準會政策會傳導成更低、更穩定的長端殖利率。

items.title: US Rates Weekly: Can Secretary Bessent and Chair Warsh save the curve?
items.quote: We stay bearish on short-expiry vols and see room for the vol term structures to steepen further.
items.quote_zh: 我們維持看空短天期波動率，並認為波動率的期限結構還有繼續陡峭化的空間。

items.title: US Economics Weekly: The resilient narrative of US resilience

items.quote_zh: 雖然可能有許多因素在推升殖利率，但我們要指出，近期的總體基本面看起來與更高的殖利率並不一致。

items.title: US Economics Weekly: The resilient narrative of US resilience
items.quote: While longer-end yields are not abnormally high compared to short-end yields across their history, the unexpected announcement does suggest a degree of discomfort with recent moves higher in yields.
items.quote_zh: 雖然以歷史來看，長端殖利率相對短端並沒有異常偏高，但這個未被預期的宣布，確實透露出對近期殖利率上行的某種不適。

items.quote: And while investment related to AI-demand is a substantial driver of growth, not all this demand is boosting domestic production.

items.title: Asia Insights: Thailand: The high concentration of FDI inflows into data centers

items.title: Global Credit Trader: IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain
items.quote: In response to the oil shock, central banks have pivoted toward somewhat tighter policy. items.quote_zh: 為因應油價衝擊，各國央行已轉向略為緊縮的政策。在我們追蹤的 27 家主要央行中，有 17 家的政策利率預測被上修，其中巴西上修 175 個基點、印尼 125 個基點、英國與南非各 100 個基點。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain
items.quote: If he fails to tackle these issues head on, he ultimately may be pressed to demonstrate his inflation-fighting commitment by actually hiking rates. items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain

items.title: Economic Insights: US – Election timing favors Fed patience
items.quote: The election calendar provides some additional support for that call on the margin.
items.quote_zh: 選舉行事曆在邊際上為這個判斷提供了一些額外的支撐。

items.title: Economic Insights: US – Election timing favors Fed patience
items.quote: Our Fed forecast is premised on the inflation outlook rather than the election cycle.
items.quote_zh: 我們的聯準會預測是建立在通膨展望之上，而不是選舉週期。

items.title: Economic Insights: US – Election timing favors Fed patience
items.quote: June core PCE inflation slowed noticeably to 0.132% m-o-m.
items.quote_zh: 6 月核心 PCE 通膨月增率明顯放緩至 0.132%。

items.title: Asia Insights: Indonesia: BI stays on hold and signals policy continuity
items.quote: We maintain our forecast that BI will hike by another 50bp in Q4, owing to balance of payments pressures likely persisting, but acknowledge uncertainty remains high.
items.quote_zh: 我們維持印尼央行第四季將再升息 50 個基點的預測，理由是國際收支壓力可能持續，但我們也承認不確定性依然很高。

items.title: Asia Insights: Indonesia: BI stays on hold and signals policy continuity
items.quote: this could exacerbate BOP pressures and elicit more concerns over central bank independence, at a time when the current account deficit is set to widen again, based on our forecast.
items.quote_zh: 在我們預估經常帳赤字將再度擴大的此刻，這可能加劇國際收支壓力，並引來更多對央行獨立性的疑慮。

items.title: Asia Insights: Indonesia: BI stays on hold and signals policy continuity
items.quote: We believe it also remains to be seen whether the expansion to FDI will be effective, as these are longer-term inflows that may not be sensitive to FX fluctuations.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為，把誘因擴大到外人直接投資是否有效仍有待觀察，因為那是對匯率波動未必敏感的長期資金。

items.title: Special Report: Chipnomics: Introducing Nomura's Chip Shortage Index
items.quote: However, a CSI shock is more persistent and can sustain higher chip prices for more than the average chip upcycle of 24 months
items.quote_zh: 然而，CSI 衝擊的持續性更高，可以把較高的晶片價格維持超過 24 個月這個平均晶片上行期的長度。

items.title: Special Report: Chipnomics: Introducing Nomura's Chip Shortage Index
items.quote: Korea supplies the constrained chip input, so changes in chip scarcity now feed directly into exports, income and liquidity via chip price surges and the trade surplus
items.quote_zh: 韓國供應的正是那個受限的晶片投入品，因此晶片稀缺程度的變化，如今會透過晶片價格飆升與貿易順差，直接傳導到出口、所得與流動性。

items.title: Special Report: Chipnomics: Introducing Nomura's Chip Shortage Index
items.quote: A persistent bottleneck can lift the average price level and amplify the cycle, but it does not prevent the eventual downturn.
items.quote_zh: 持續性的瓶頸可以抬高平均價格水準並放大循環，但它無法阻止最終的下行。

items.title: Top of Mind: Assessing a less transparent Fed
items.quote: Markets price what they think the Fed will do, not what they think the Fed should do.
items.quote_zh: 市場定價的是他們認為聯準會會做什麼，而不是他們認為聯準會應該做什麼。

items.title: Top of Mind: Assessing a less transparent Fed
items.quote: I sympathize with Chairman Warsh to some extent. [But] the real problem with Warsh’s approach is his reluctance to articulate
items.quote_zh: 我在某種程度上同情 Warsh 主席。[但] 他這套做法真正的問題，在於他不願意說清楚⋯⋯（不願說明 FOMC 如何看待經濟的演變）。

items.title: Top of Mind: Assessing a less transparent Fed
items.quote: Reducing guidance generates more volatility but also more signal...
items.quote_zh: 減少指引會製造更多波動，但也會製造更多訊號⋯⋯

items.title: Oil Monitor: At visible draw rates, when do we "run out" of oil stockpiles?
items.quote: As an exercise, we project these forward, implying that OECD stockpiles could dwindle to ~70 days of
items.quote_zh: 作為一次演練，我們把這些速度往前外推，意味著 OECD 的庫存可能降到約 70 天的覆蓋水準。

items.title: Oil Monitor: At visible draw rates, when do we "run out" of oil stockpiles?
items.quote: ~70 days of cover was the level reached in the Second Oil Shock of the 1970s-80s when energy spend reached ~8% of GDP, equivalent to all-in prices reaching >$200/bbl, from
items.quote_zh: 約 70 天的庫存覆蓋，是 1970–80 年代第二次石油危機時到過的水準，當時能源支出達到 GDP 的約 8%，換算成全包油價相當於每桶超過 200 美元。

items.title: Oil Monitor: At visible draw rates, when do we "run out" of oil stockpiles?
items.quote: Still, while this implies tank bottoms are not as imminent on a macro total oil+products level, specific refined products (especially diesel) are already facing distress now, which could worsen further, meaning more localized,
items.quote_zh: 不過，儘管這意味著在總體原油加成品油的層面上，油缸見底沒有那麼迫在眉睫，特定的成品油（尤其是柴油）現在就已經面臨壓力，而且可能繼續惡化，意味著會出現更局部性的問題。

items.title: Oil Monitor: At visible draw rates, when do we "run out" of oil stockpiles?
items.quote: While our base case remains that a deal and reopening eventually take place, penciled in for 4Q’26, where Brent could return to the $60s in 2027, our bull case recognizes that the Strait could be partially disrupted for longer, past the US midterm elections and beyond, with Brent back in the $110 range.
items.quote_zh: 我們的基準情境仍是最終達成協議並重新開放，時點暫定在 2026 年第四季，屆時 Brent 可能在 2027 年回到 60 美元區間；但我們的多頭情境認為，荷莫茲海峽可能維持部分中斷更久，越過美國期中選舉甚至更遠，Brent 會回到 110 美元一帶。

items.title: Richard Koo: How will Japan and US address the risks of inflation and falling behind the curve?
items.quote: Chair Warsh may therefore intend to use the events of the past 42 days as evidence to persuade President Trump of the need for a rate hike.
items.quote_zh: 因此 Warsh 主席可能打算把過去 42 天發生的事，當成說服川普總統需要升息的證據。

items.title: Richard Koo: How will Japan and US address the risks of inflation and falling behind the curve?
items.quote: That suggests the Fed may try to stamp out inflation even without raising the policy rate by using QT to lift long-term interest rates.
items.quote_zh: 這意味著聯準會可能不調升政策利率，而是用量化緊縮把長天期利率推高來撲滅通膨。

items.title: Richard Koo: How will Japan and US address the risks of inflation and falling behind the curve?
items.quote: the economy is strong from the perspective of AI-related industries and their shareholders, while elsewhere conditions remain quite unfavorable
items.quote_zh: 從 AI 相關產業與它們股東的角度看，經濟很強；其他地方的狀況則相當不利。

items.title: Richard Koo: How will Japan and US address the risks of inflation and falling behind the curve?
items.quote: the problem lies with the Bank of Japan’s lack of response to inflation, which needs to be promptly rectified
items.quote_zh: 問題出在日本銀行對通膨缺乏回應，這需要盡快矯正。

items.title: European Economics Analyst: Germany—A Cyclically Loose but Structurally Tighter Labour Market
items.quote: This loosening since late 2023 primarily reflects weaker labour demand.
items.quote_zh: 2023 年底以來的這輪鬆動，主要反映的是較弱的勞動需求。

items.title: European Economics Analyst: Germany—A Cyclically Loose but Structurally Tighter Labour Market
items.quote: Over the next decade, however, we expect labour supply to contract by about 0.4% annually, becoming a drag on growth.
items.quote_zh: 然而在未來十年，我們預期勞動供給每年將萎縮約 0.4%，成為成長的拖累。

items.title: European Economics Analyst: Germany—A Cyclically Loose but Structurally Tighter Labour Market
items.quote: Given this contraction in labour supply, the softer labour demand implied by announced job cuts should not translate into materially higher unemployment.
items.quote_zh: 考慮到勞動供給的這種萎縮，企業宣布的裁員所隱含的較弱勞動需求，不應該轉化為明顯更高的失業率。

items.title: Global Economics Analyst: What Has the World Learned About Central Bank Communication?
items.quote: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh aims to revise the FOMC’s communication strategy, with a goal of streamlining information and limiting forward guidance.
items.quote_zh: 聯準會主席華許意在修改 FOMC 的溝通策略，目標是精簡資訊並限縮前瞻指引。

items.title: Global Economics Analyst: What Has the World Learned About Central Bank Communication?
items.quote: the transmission of policy surprises to our financial conditions indices (GS FCIs) is only 70% as effective for central banks at the median of the historical surprise distribution (vs. a no surprise benchmark)
items.quote_zh: 對位於歷史驚奇分布中位數的央行而言，政策驚奇傳導到我們金融條件指數（GS FCIs）的效果，只有無驚奇基準的 70%。

items.title: Global Economics Analyst: What Has the World Learned About Central Bank Communication?
items.quote: a modest pullback in FOMC communication and transparency could bring it back in line with other major central banks without imposing significant costs. At the same time, a more significant shift away from current best practice may make monetary policy less effective.
items.quote_zh: FOMC 在溝通與透明度上溫和地往回收，可以讓它回到與其他主要央行一致的水準，而不會付出重大代價。但同時，若更大幅度地偏離目前的最佳實務，可能會讓貨幣政策的效果下降。

items.title: Power Tracker: PJM and ERCOT: Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: We continue to emphasize the structural tightening in PJM only modestly offset by emergency response plans, reinforcing our view of critical tightness in PJM through 2030.
items.quote_zh: 我們持續強調 PJM 的結構性趨緊，緊急應變計畫只能小幅抵銷，這強化了我們對 PJM 到 2030 年前處於臨界緊俏的看法。

items.title: Power Tracker: PJM and ERCOT: Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: ERCOT peak day-ahead pricing is tracking near multi-year lows (Exhibit 1) due to ample available supply, consistent with our regional divergence view that ERCOT has entered a softening path since late-2025, driven by capacity expansion efforts (especially solar and batteries) and improving real-time operational effectiveness
items.quote_zh: 由於可用供給充裕，ERCOT 的日前尖峰電價正貼近多年低點（圖表 1），這與我們的區域分歧觀點一致：ERCOT 自 2025 年底起已進入軟化路徑，動力來自容量擴建（尤其是太陽能與電池）以及即時調度效能的改善。

items.title: Power Tracker: PJM and ERCOT: Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: we expect this gap to reinforce the trend of new data centers favoring better-supplied regional power markets, such as ERCOT
items.quote_zh: 我們預期這道缺口會強化新建資料中心偏好供給較充裕的區域電力市場（例如 ERCOT）的趨勢。

items.title: Power Tracker: PJM and ERCOT: Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: On July 23, FERC held a technical conference with White House Officials and PJM stakeholders to address supply-reliability concerns, discussing measures such as breaking up PJM’s service territory and governance reform, ultimately issuing an end of September deadline to convene on solutions provided by PJM stakeholders.
items.quote_zh: 7 月 23 日，FERC 與白宮官員及 PJM 利害關係人召開技術會議，處理供給可靠度的疑慮，討論了拆分 PJM 服務區域與治理改革等措施，最後訂下 9 月底的期限，要求 PJM 利害關係人提出解方後再行商議。

items.title: Top of Mind: IPO surge: a red flag for markets?
items.quote: I’m less worried [about the surge in new issuance] than the average investor
items.quote_zh: 對這波發行量激增，我比一般投資人不擔心

items.title: Top of Mind: IPO surge: a red flag for markets?
items.quote: Historically, issuance waves paired with capex waves… have generally resulted in disappointing returns for equity holders.
items.quote_zh: 歷史上，發行浪潮疊上資本支出浪潮，對股東而言通常以令人失望的報酬收場。

items.title: Top of Mind: IPO surge: a red flag for markets?
items.quote: This acceleration in supply has weighed on sector spreads.
items.quote_zh: 供給加速已經壓抑了該板塊的利差表現。

items.title: Top of Mind: IPO surge: a red flag for markets?
items.quote: A pipeline of over 400 active applications and ample market liquidity should sustain heightened IPO activity.
items.quote_zh: 逾 400 件在審申請案與充裕的市場流動性，應能支撐居高的 IPO 活動。

items.title: Top of Mind: An AI job apocalypse?
items.quote: that the AI transition could lead to the displacement of over 9%
items.quote_zh: 這一輪 AI 轉型可能造成超過 9% 的勞工被位移

items.title: Top of Mind: An AI job apocalypse?
items.quote: AI is coming just as the rising tide is, but not without warning.
items.quote_zh: AI 就像正在上漲的潮水一樣會來，但不會毫無預警。

items.title: Top of Mind: An AI job apocalypse?
items.quote: So, I expect only a small net negative impact on labor over the
items.quote_zh: 所以，我預期 AI 對勞動只會有小幅的淨負面影響

items.title: Top of Mind: An AI job apocalypse?
items.quote: investors are not yet confident that AI-driven productivity gains
items.quote_zh: 投資人還不相信 AI 驅動的生產力增益
